def: to render infamous, i.e. (by implication) contemn or maltreat
kjv: despise, dishonour, suffer shame, entreat shamefully

occurrences.text: And again he sent another servant: and they beat him also, and entreated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.
Jesus answered, I have not a devil; but I honour my Father, and ye do dishonour me.
And they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name.
Wherefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts, to dishonour their own bodies between themselves:
Thou that makest thy boast of the law, through breaking the law dishonourest thou God?
But ye have despised the poor. Do not rich men oppress you, and draw you before the judgment seats?

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
